definition: Address Information Engineering studies addresses as information infrastructure that connects people, places, institutions, logistics, and time.

groups.name: societal implementation
groups.japaneseName: 安全・制度・社会実装

domains.name: Address Ontology
domains.specialization: foundational concepts for addressable entities, places, delivery points, and institutions
domains.nonClaim: An ontology does not prove a place exists, is current, or is deliverable.

domains.name: Address Morphism Theory
domains.specialization: formal address mappings, safe resolution conditions, and theory manuscripts
domains.nonClaim: A mapping model does not guarantee unique resolution, cryptographic security, or delivery success.

domains.name: Address Formal Languages
domains.specialization: address grammars, tokenization, parsing, rendering, and multilingual notation
domains.nonClaim: A syntactically valid expression is not evidence of identity, existence, or deliverability.

domains.name: Address Semantics
domains.specialization: purpose-dependent meaning of address components and delivery instructions
domains.nonClaim: A semantic interpretation does not establish legal authority or recipient intent.

domains.name: Address Spatial Information
domains.specialization: spatial relations among addresses, features, grids, entrances, and delivery points
domains.nonClaim: Spatial proximity does not prove address identity or carrier reachability.

domains.name: Address Topology
domains.specialization: containment, adjacency, access, and overlapping administrative or delivery structures
domains.nonClaim: A containment or adjacency relation does not establish a current delivery route.

domains.name: Address Temporal Information
domains.specialization: address lineage, validity periods, and historical change events
domains.nonClaim: A lineage edge does not prove uninterrupted social, legal, or occupancy identity.

domains.name: Address Identity and Identifiers
domains.japaneseName: 住所同一性・識別子論
domains.specialization: persistent identifiers, referent identity, and split or merge continuity
domains.nonClaim: A persistent identifier does not prove ownership, residency, or current reachability.

domains.name: Address Data Systems
domains.japaneseName: 住所データ構造・データベース論
domains.specialization: typed schemas, address databases, provenance, and distributed data models
domains.nonClaim: A database schema does not make source data complete, licensed, or authoritative.

domains.name: Address Algorithms
domains.specialization: parsing, normalization, candidate generation, matching, and error correction
domains.nonClaim: An algorithmic score does not establish a correct address or authorize an automated decision.

domains.name: Address Probabilistic Inference
domains.japaneseName: 確率的住所推論・住所AI
domains.specialization: uncertainty-aware candidate ranking, machine learning, and human-review thresholds
domains.nonClaim: A probability estimate does not justify silently selecting a recipient location.

domains.name: Address Systems and Networking
domains.japaneseName: 住所システム・ネットワーク論
domains.specialization: interoperability, federation, synchronization, and fault-tolerant address exchange
domains.nonClaim: An interoperable protocol does not guarantee remote service availability or delivery execution.

domains.name: Address Security and Privacy Engineering
domains.japaneseName: 住所セキュリティ・プライバシー工学
domains.specialization: minimal disclosure, access control, threat modeling, and privacy-preserving proofs
domains.nonClaim: A privacy design does not make a person anonymous or establish a cryptographic security proof.

domains.name: Address Quality and Validation Engineering
domains.specialization: multi-layer quality assessment, validation evidence, freshness, and failure states
domains.nonClaim: A validation result does not prove residency, legal validity, or universal deliverability.

domains.name: Address Standards and Governance
domains.japaneseName: 住所標準化・制度設計学
domains.specialization: standards mapping, institutional responsibilities, and cross-border governance
domains.nonClaim: A standards profile does not replace law, official authority, or local operational rules.

domains.name: Address UX and Social Implementation
domains.specialization: human input, review, sharing, accessibility, and equitable address use
domains.nonClaim: A usable interface does not prove that an entered address is correct or safe to disclose.
